subject: Post-discovery: book throughput & latency sizing session
messages:
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@payflux.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: book throughput & latency sizing session

Hi Ari —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap from our side: PayFlux is evaluating Redwood for the payment-notifications and real-time fraud scoring pipeline. Key targets you mentioned were high-concurrency inference for short prompts (avg 32 tokens) and strict latency at the p95.

Next step we suggested is a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) where we’ll: 
- Review your traffic profile and QPS peaks
- Align on p50/p95 latency SLOs and tail behavior
- Confirm model/quantization options and KV cache usage
- Produce a draft Dedicated pool sizing recommendation + action items

Attached is a short checklist that will help the call run efficiently. Can you confirm who from your infra/ML team will join and which of these windows work for you (Pacific times):

Option A: Tue Nov 7, 10:00–11:00 PT
Option B: Wed Nov 8, 14:00–15:00 PT
Option C: Thu Nov 9, 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of these work, suggest two windows and we’ll adapt. Also, if you can drop a small traffic sample (CSV) ahead of the call that shows request rates by minute and average prompt length, that will let us pre-run a quick cost/throughput estimate.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa (solutions) and Sean (runtime) so we have the right folks on the sizing exercise.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood-sizing-checklist.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@payflux.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: book throughput & latency sizing session

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the recap and the checklist. Quick responses:
- Attendees: Ari Kaplan (platform lead), Jordan Li (infra eng), Mei Chen (ML infra) — I’ll ask Jordan to join the calendar invite when you send it.
- Availability: Option B (Wed Nov 8, 14:00–15:00 PT) is best for our team.

High-level traffic notes to seed the session:
- Baseline: 25–40 qps during steady hours, ~200 qps peak bursts (5–10 min bursts)
- Concurrency target for us is ~1,000 concurrent active users during peak events (many short inference calls per user)
- Latency objective: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for the inference path (end-to-end from request to token stream)
- Average prompt length ~32 tokens, context window predictable (<= 512 tokens)

I attached a redacted minute-level sample that shows request rates and prompt-length distribution — hope that helps. Please let us know if you need additional telemetry (KV hit rates, cold-start traces) ahead of the call.

On a separate note — we’re evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted for this workload; if you can prepare a short cost delta for a conservative Dedicated pool and a burstable hosted fallback, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Platform Lead | PayFlux
ari.kaplan@payflux.com

Attachments:
- payflux_traffic_sample.csv (attachment stub)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@payflux.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: book throughput & latency sizing session

Thanks Ari — Wed Nov 8 14:00 PT works; I’ve created a tentative calendar event and added Jordan/Mei (please accept when you can). Agenda and pre-read are attached in the invite.

Quick logistical notes: 
- Call will be 60m; please plan for the first 20m for traffic/profile review, 25m for sizing and runtime options, and 15m for action items and next steps.
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/987654321 (I updated the deal stage to "Sizing" and added Priyom & Sean as owners).
- Prep ask for PayFlux: if you can upload the minute-level sample to the shared folder or paste a short CSV snippet in the event, Sean will pre-run a rough batch-sizing estimate.

Looking forward — Priyom, Sean: will you bring the Dedicated pool draft and a quick hosted-burst fallback sketch?

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
